name: generate_image
description: Generate an image from a text prompt. Builds a txt2img workflow, fills unspecified params from defaults, auto-selects a checkpoint.

name: generate_with_controlnet
description: Generate an image conditioned by a ControlNet (pose/depth/canny/normal) and text prompt.

name: generate_with_ip_adapter
description: Generate an image guided by a reference image's style/subject via IP-Adapter.

name: generate_audio
description: Generate audio from a text prompt using ACE Step 1.5 (music) or Stable Audio 3 (music, instruments, SFX).

name: view_image
description: Return a generated asset's bytes as an inline image so the agent can see the result.

name: analyze_color
description: Get palette, contrast, and color statistics for a generated image.

name: regenerate
description: Re-run the workflow that produced an asset, with optional parameter overrides.

name: list_assets
description: Browse recently generated assets sorted by newest first.

name: get_asset_metadata
description: Get full provenance for an asset, including the originating workflow.

name: get_defaults
description: Show merged generation defaults with per-source attribution.

name: set_defaults
description: Update runtime defaults; persist: true writes the config file.

name: enqueue_workflow
description: Submit a workflow (API format JSON) and return prompt_id immediately (non-blocking).

name: get_job_status
description: Check execution status of a job by prompt ID.

name: get_queue
description: View the current execution queue (running + pending).

name: get_queued_workflow
description: Inspect the full workflow payload for one pending queue item.

name: move_queued_job
description: Move a pending job to the front/back by requeueing.

name: edit_queued_job
description: Patch or replace a pending queued workflow and requeue.

name: cancel_job
description: Interrupt the currently running job with escalation logic.

name: get_system_stats
description: Get system info: GPU, VRAM, Python version, OS.

name: visualize_workflow
description: Convert a workflow to a Mermaid flowchart with nodes grouped by category.

name: mermaid_to_workflow
description: Convert a Mermaid diagram back to executable workflow JSON.

name: create_workflow
description: Generate a workflow from templates: txt2img, img2img, upscale, inpaint, controlnet, ip_adapter, ace_step_15, stable_audio_3.

name: modify_workflow
description: Apply operations to a workflow: set_input, add_node, remove_node, connect, insert_between.

name: get_node_info
description: Query available node types from ComfyUI's /object_info endpoint.

name: validate_workflow
description: Dry-run validation: check missing nodes, broken connections, invalid outputs, missing models.

name: list_workflows
description: List saved workflows from ComfyUI's user library.

name: get_workflow
description: Load a specific saved workflow by filename.

name: strip_workflow
description: De-virtualize any workflow: resolve GetNode/SetNode buses, Reroutes, subgraph defs, bypassed nodes into real connections.

name: slice_workflow
description: Un-chunk a toggle-template monolith: slice one rgthree Fast-Groups-Bypass-toggled pipeline out into a standalone graph.

name: save_workflow
description: Save a workflow to the ComfyUI user library.

name: upload_image
description: Copy a local image into ComfyUI's input/ directory for img2img, inpaint, or ControlNet.

name: workflow_from_image
description: Extract embedded workflow metadata from a ComfyUI-generated PNG.

name: list_output_images
description: Browse recently generated images and videos from the output directory, sorted newest-first.

name: search_models
description: Search HuggingFace for compatible models (checkpoints, LoRAs, VAEs, etc.).

name: download_model
description: Download a model from a URL to the correct ComfyUI subdirectory.

name: list_local_models
description: List installed models by type: checkpoints, loras, vae, upscale_models, controlnet, embeddings, clip, unet, diffusion_models, text_encoders.

name: list_extra_paths
description: View standalone or Desktop ComfyUI extra search-path config.

name: add_extra_path
description: Add a model/custom_nodes search path to the extra paths YAML.

name: remove_extra_path
description: Remove a stored extra search path from the extra paths YAML.

name: clear_vram
description: Free GPU VRAM by unloading cached models, report before/after stats.

name: get_embeddings
description: List installed textual inversion embeddings.

name: search_custom_nodes
description: Search the ComfyUI Registry for custom node packs by keyword.

name: get_node_pack_details
description: Get full details of a custom node pack (description, author, nodes, install info).

name: generate_node_skill
description: Generate a Claude skill .md file from a Registry ID or GitHub URL.

name: comfy_cli_search_nodes
description: Search actual loaded node classes through official comfy nodes search.

name: get_logs
description: Get ComfyUI server logs with optional keyword filter (e.g., error, warning).

name: get_history
description: Get execution history with full error details, Python tracebacks, timing, and cached node info.

name: stop_comfyui
description: Stop the running ComfyUI process (saves PID and launch args for restart).

name: start_comfyui
description: Start ComfyUI using info saved from a previous stop.

name: restart_comfyui
description: Stop and restart ComfyUI, preserving all launch arguments.

name: suggest_settings
description: Suggest proven sampler/scheduler/steps/CFG settings from local generation history.

name: generation_stats
description: Show local generation tracking statistics: total runs, unique combos, breakdown by model family.
